select

select
from repair_order r left join lab l on l.id = r.lab_id left join device d on d.id = r.device_id where r.order_no = #{id} or cast(r.id as char) = #{id} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into repair_order ( order_no, lab_id, device_id, fault_type, created_at, assignee_name, description, result_desc, contact ) values ( #{record.recordNo}, #{labId}, #{deviceId}, #{record.maintenanceType}, #{record.maintenanceDate}, #{record.maintainer}, #{record.content}, #{record.result}, #{record.remark} )
mapper.update: update repair_order set lab_id = #{labId}, device_id = #{deviceId}, fault_type = #{record.maintenanceType}, created_at = #{record.maintenanceDate}, assignee_name = #{record.maintainer}, description = #{record.content}, result_desc = #{record.result}, contact = #{record.remark}, updated_at = now() where order_no = #{id} or cast(id as char) = #{id}
mapper.delete: delete from repair_order where order_no = #{id} or cast(id as char) = #{id}
